_note: Written from the source at the pinned commits before grading. Each fact scores 1 (stated correctly), 0.5 (partly) or 0 (missing or wrong). Each listed wrong claim the answer makes costs 1 point. Score = (facts - wrong claims) / number of facts, floored at 0.

facts: Entry is Flask.__call__ -> wsgi_app (src/flask/app.py); at this commit one AppContext carries the request (no separate RequestContext)
full_dispatch_request sends request_started, runs preprocess_request (before_request), then dispatch_request calls the view
handle_user_exception looks for a registered error handler; with none it re-raises
wsgi_app's except Exception sets error and calls handle_exception
got_request_exception is sent inside handle_exception, first, before the PROPAGATE check and logging
PROPAGATE_EXCEPTIONS (None -> testing or debug) re-raises; otherwise log_exception, InternalServerError(original_exception=e), 500 handler if any
finalize_request(from_error_handler=True) -> process_response runs after_request functions on the 500 response

finally: ctx.pop(error) -> do_teardown_request (reverse order, each gets the original exception), request close, then do_teardown_appcontext (reverse, same exception); callbacks all run and errors are collected
wrong_claims: after_request functions are skipped for an unhandled exception
a separate RequestContext is pushed/popped at this commit
teardown runs before the response is produced

facts: Default router is SmartRouter with [RegExpRouter, TrieRouter] (src/hono.ts)
SmartRouter.add only buffers routes (#routes); the underlying routers see nothing yet
On the first match it replays all routes into each router in order and calls match
It falls back on UnsupportedPathError (the router cannot express the route set), not on a missed match
Names at least one real cause (duplicate path, capturing group or .* in a custom regex, ambiguous sibling patterns)
After choosing: match is rebound to the chosen router, the list shrinks to it, routes are dropped, name becomes 'SmartRouter + X'
Adding a route after the first request throws MESSAGE_MATCHER_IS_ALREADY_BUILT ('Can not add a route since the matcher is already built.')
wrong_claims: routes are added to every underlying router as they are registered
it falls back when a router fails to match the request
the late-add error is 'No active router has been determined yet.'

facts: Retries only while retryCount < limit, and only for methods in retry.methods (POST/PATCH not by default)
The status must be in retry.statusCodes (defaults 408, 413, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504)
A shouldRetry function is consulted first and can force or forbid a retry
Header order: Retry-After, RateLimit-Reset, X-RateLimit-Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Reset, X-Rate-Limit-Reset
Server-provided wait is used only for retry.afterStatusCodes (413, 429, 503)
Formats: seconds; HTTP date (Date.parse - now); large numbers treated as a timestamp (threshold 2024-01-01); negative clamped to 0; unparseable falls back to computed backoff
Server wait is min(maxRetryAfter, after) with no jitter and no backoffLimit
Computed backoff: retry.delay(n) (default 0.3 * 2^(n-1) * 1000), jitter true = random * delay or a function (invalid result ignored), then min(backoffLimit)
A 413 without the Retry-After path is not retried
wrong_claims: jitter or backoffLimit apply to the Retry-After wait
Retry-After is honoured for every retried status code
invents a header or option that does not exist
